correctness.rationale: The exact maximum F(3,4)=5 is reconstructed from the inspected full-text structure proof: for the selected minimal maximum at q=4 only types III and IV remain; their proved bounds are at most 5 and exactly 5 respectively, and five-word witnesses exist. The embedded verifier independently enumerates every five-word subset containing 000, checks the descendant-parent-intersection definition, obtains 4320 normalized maxima, canonically quotients the exact natural equivalence relation into three classes, and derives the full 55296 census and stabilizers by incidence and orbit-stabilizer. The finite claim makes no extrapolation beyond q=4, length three, coalition size two.

value.rationale: The result is a natural complete equality classification at a named exact benchmark, not a recomputation of the known value five. It exposes a structural limitation of the classical extremal proof: the partial-order minimization preserves the optimum but removes one entire equality orbit, represented by a three-color 2-clique binding plus an isolated vertex. The exact census, orbits, and stabilizers provide reusable benchmarks for code equivalence and small-parameter IPP computations.
